$comment: Arma2 Torneos · Multimedia Staging — Hetzner Cloud Firewall specification.
TEMPLATE. NOT CREATED. No Hetzner API call has been made by this change and
no VM, firewall, network or volume exists. This file is the reviewable
description of the resource a future, separately authorized step would ask
for; it is not read by any tool in this repository.
WHY BOTH THIS AND nftables-host.staging.nft
Hetzner Cloud Firewall is enforced in the network fabric, OUTSIDE the VM.
Root inside the VM cannot flush it, so it is the only layer that still
holds after a full host compromise. It is also stateful and address/port
based, which means it can express 'only this CIDR may open tcp/22' and
cannot express anything about which HTTPS endpoint is being reached.
nftables inside the VM is the opposite trade: bypassable by host root,
but able to see the docker bridge subnets and write per-service rules.
Neither replaces the other and neither identifies Supabase Staging.
OUTBOUND RULES ARE PRESENT AND DELIBERATELY COARSE
Hetzner applies outbound rules only when at least one is defined; a
firewall with inbound rules only leaves egress unrestricted. The rules
below therefore exist to make egress DEFINED, not because tcp/443 to
0.0.0.0/0 is a meaningful restriction. It is not. It permits every HTTPS
host on the internet, Production's API host included. Production is
refused by the compiled block in the workers' target.mjs; nothing at this
layer contributes to that guarantee.
BEFORE APPLYING
Replace ADMIN_CIDR_PLACEHOLDER. Applying with the placeholder in place is
rejected by the API (not a valid CIDR), which is the intended failure:
no personal address is committed to this repository, and a firewall that
silently defaults to 0.0.0.0/0 on tcp/22 is worse than no firewall.
name: arma2-media-staging

rules.$comment: Administrative SSH. The only inbound service. No container port is published by docker-compose.staging.yml, so there is nothing else to open.
Diagnostics. Without it, an unreachable host cannot be distinguished from a firewalled one, and PMTU black holes are invisible.

HTTPS out: Supabase Staging for the processor and the renewer, the ClamAV mirrors for freshclam, the container registry for image pulls, the distribution mirrors for apt. All four are indistinguishable at this layer.
HTTP out: apt on the Hetzner Debian mirrors, and the ClamAV mirrors that still redirect through 80.
rules.description: HTTP egress for package and signature mirrors

rules.$comment: DNS-over-TLS to the two upstreams unbound forwards to. Plain udp/53 egress is intentionally absent, so a process that ignores the local resolver cannot query a public one directly.
NTP. A skewed clock produces attestations with wrong validity windows on both ends and TLS failures with no visible cause.
ICMP out. Path-MTU discovery on a NAT'd cloud network is not optional: without frag-needed, large TLS responses hang rather than fail.
